addon.notes:
# New

### Augmentation (Unity)
* Added a new Augmentation feature which allows augmenting Unity equipment. It currently supports initially opening the item up for augmentation (1 lustreless item + 30k unity accolades), as well as augmenting the item up to R15.

### Commands
* Added a `keep` command: `//keep <item> <count>` which brings only the designated amount of an item to your inventory.
* Added an "Itemizer Name Matching" setting under Settings > Behavior. Strict (default) now matches the exact item name like the original Itemizer. Loose matches partial names and keywords. This works for `get` / `put` / `move` / `drop` .

### Bazaar
* Improved Bazaar Search to behave more naturally. It now checks, browses, then leaves per player with random delays in between to populate the catalog, then buys items by rechecking the bazaar of the player selling the item.

# Bugfixes
* Fixed a bug where the ingame `//organize` command did not use the same logic as the in-app organize function.
* `//drop` on a stack now reports the actual number of items dropped instead of always saying 1.
